tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskang ba dang*/ bshags pa rje rang byung bas mdzad pa

bzhugs so// ༄༅// hūṃ chos dbyings bde chen gzhal yas nas// dur khrod brgyad kyi gzhal yas nas// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas la sogs// khyad par o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// hūṃ chos dbyings rnams dag ngang nyid las// 'gro ba'i las mkhan don du ni// ye shes sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed// rje btsun ma yi thugs dam bskang*// dbang gi sku mdog dmar mo ste// gzugs 'dzin spang phyir gcer bu nyid// bcu drug chas 'dzin gzhon sgeg 'dzum// bde stong lhan skyes thugs dam bskang*// don dam mi 'gyur gzhal yas nas// thugs rje'i spyan gsum dug gsum mkhyen// khams gsum gdul bya kun la gzigs// srid gsum 'dul mdzad thugs dam bskang*// sku dang ye shes dbyer med pas// zhe sdang 'dul phyir mche ba bzhi// cung zad gtsigs pas bdud bzhi 'joms// zhal nas khrag 'dzag thugs dam bskang*// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol phyir// dbu skra sil bu nyil ba las// snyan cha gtsug gi nor bus brgyan// rgyan gyi brgyan pa'i thugs= bden gnyis zung 'jug phyag g.yas nas// shes rab gri gug 'bar ba yis// gdon nad nyon mongs gzung 'dzin gcod// bdud 'dul rgyal ma'i= g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang*// zag med bde ba'i ros tshim phyir// shes rab ḍa ma ru sgra sgrog /kha ṭwāṃ bsnams pa'i= ā l̥ kā l̥ rnam dag phyir// rgya phyed mgo yi phreng bas rgyan// dar gyi cod pan bar snang lding*// dri med mkha' 'gro'i= gdul bya'i rigs can tha dad la// gang la ci ston de 'dul phyir// rus pa dang ni rin po che// brgyan cha 'chang ba'i= dran pa nyer bzhag ngo bo nyid// rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus su// rol pa'i khro mo mtshan dpes brgyan// mtshan ldan phag mo'i thugs= chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nas// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus// sna tshogs padma nyi ma'i gdan// 'gying bag can gyi=

rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang*// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro du mas bskor// bde stong bskyed mdzad mkha' 'gro ma// lhan skyes yab yum thugs= sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud 'dzin ma// 'gro ba'i don du khyod sgrub phyir// ci bsam dngos grub ma lus pa// 'di nyid bdag la brtsal du gsol// rnal 'byor ma yi thugs= hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten nas// dbus phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// mtha' dang bral ba'i zhing khams nas// sangs rgyas rigs kyi gsang ba'i yum// dkar mo gar tshul rab sgeg ma// gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams// de bzhin rigs kyi ḍā ki rnams// rigs 'dzin phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*// hūṃ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// shar phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dur khrod du// rdo rje rigs kyi gsang ba'i yum// sngon mo gar tshul rab sgeg ma/ gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams// rdo rje rigs kyi ḍa ki rnams// rig 'dzin= bskang ngo = hūm̐ stong gsum= lho phyogs= dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams nas// rin chen rigs= ser mo gar tshul rab sgeg ma// gri gug= rin chen rigs= rig 'dzin= bskang ngo = hūm̐ stong gsum stong = nub phyogs= padma can= padma= dmar mo gar tshul= gri gug= padma rigs kyi ḍā ki rnams// rigs 'dzin phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bskang ngo = stong gsum= byang = rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas na// las kyi rigs= ljang mo= gri gug thod= las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// rig 'dzin= bskang ngo = hūm̐ shar lho gshin rje'i bstan ma ni// sngo ser phyed gzugs khro gtum ldan// phyag na ḍa ru dag brdungs pas// nyi ma dang po mgo bo 'khor bar mdzad// bskang ngo khyod= hūm̐ lho nub gshin rje'i 'jigs ma ni// dmar ser phyed gzugs stobs chen mo// phyag na thod khrag bsnams pa yis// nyi ma gnyis pa khrag tu skyug bar mdzad// bkang ngo =

hūm̐ nub byang gshin rje'i mche ba can/ dmar ljang phyed gzugs smyo 'bog ma// phyag na kha ṭwāṃ gsor ba yis// nyi ma gsum pa rgyal bar mdzad/ bskang ngo = hūm̐ byang shar gshin rje'i pho nya mo// ljang sngon phyed gzugs dam nyams bsgral/ phyag na gro gug 'bar ba 'char// nyi ma bzhi pa dam nyams gsod mdzad ma// bskang ngo = hūm̐ shar gyi sgo bsrungs khwa gdong ma/ mkha' 'gro mi bsrun mthing nag ste// rdo rje phra men 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na rdo rje thod khrag bsnams// zhe sdang rnam dag 'gro ba 'dul// bskang ngo = hūm̐ byang gi sgo bsrungs 'ug gdong ma// ljang mo zhag gi zo ris can// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor// phyag na rgya gram thod khrag bsnams// phrag dog rnam dag mtshar gcod mdzad// bkang ngo = hūm̐ nub kyi sgo bsrungs khyi gdong ma// dmar mo zhing chen g.yang gzhi rdeb// padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskor// phyag na padma thod khrag bsnams/ khrig chags rnams dang byang chub bsgyur// bskang ngo = hūm̐ lho yi sgo bsrungs phag gdong ma// gser mdog thal chen tshom bus rgyan// rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na rin chen thod khrag bsnams// ser sna rnam dag dbul 'phongs sel// bskang ngo = hūm̐ dur khrod rgyan ldan 'jigs pa'i gzugs// ske rags gser gyi dril bus brgyan// snyan pa'i sgra sgrog si li li/ dbu rgyan dar gyi cod paṇa can// rlung gi bskyod cing pu ru ru// rkang pa rdo rje'i 'gros stabs can// mkha' la thog med spun spun 'gro// bskang ngo = hūm̐ lag pa gser gyi gdub bu can// sna tshogs gar byed khyug se khyug /de las sogs pa mtha' yas pa// ri rab lho yi 'dzam bu gling*// sems can don du bzhugs pa rnams// mos pa du ma'i sems can la// spyod pa sna tshogs thabs kyi 'dul// bskang ngo = hūm̐ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni// pu li ra ma la sogs pa'i// yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis// dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bskang ngo*/

pho brang gzhal yas phyi rol nas// dur khrod chen po brgyad dang ni// de la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad// shing chen brgyad dang zhing skyong brgyad// bskang ngo = mtsho chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad// sprin chen brgyad dang mchod rten brgyad// nags tshal brgyad dang ro langs brgyad// me brgyad ri brgyad lha chen brgyad// bskang ngo = rnal 'byor brgyad dang mkha' 'gro brgyad/ 'byung po gnod sbyin srin po brgyad// sha za srin po lto phye dang*// mi ma yin dang lus srul po// bskang ngo = bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// dam tshig nyams chag tshogs kyi bskong*// lta ba log pa gtor mas bskong*// bsrung ma g.yel na 'dzab kyi bskong*// bskang ngo = 'dir byon dam bskong phrin las mdzod// 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la brtsol// hūm̐ dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo dang*// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la rtse bar nyer dgongs nas// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas// blang dang spang bya ma shes pas// nyes par gyur pa ci mchis pa// de dag rnal 'byor ma la gshags// bdag ni 'dod chags dbang gyur pas// zang zing phyir ni nyes bsags pa// pho nya la sogs khros la sogs// de dag rnal 'byor ma la bshags// bdag ni zhe sdang dbang gyur pas// sems can rnams la lus ngag yid// gnod par gyur pa ci mchis pa// de dag rnal 'byor ma la bshags// bdag ni gti mug dbang gyur bas// bla ma rdo rje spun rnams la// lus ngag yid gsum khros pa sogs// de dag rnal 'byor ma la bshags// bdag ni rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas// rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba dang*// yan lag nyams par gyur pa rnams// de dag rnal 'byor ma la bshags// bdag ni le lo'i dbang gyur pas// gnyid dang bying rmugs dbang song nas// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams/ de dag rnal 'byor ma la bshags// de ltar bshags pas nyes dag nas// gnas skabs thun mong dngos grub bstsol// mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub ni// phyag rgya chen po thob par shog
/ces brjod nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha skang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub bya'o/// /
